scientific_rationale: Activating the frozen L093 contract unchanged. Enabled terms only: endpoint (0.4), half (0.3), type (0.3, cn_conditional); orientation weight is 0.0 and is not described. Geometry support is the proper local subset atom_slots [8,12,18,21,22]; slots 18 and 21 are context neighbors with direct geometry loss, not free background, and points outside atom_slots have no direct geometry loss though model-mediated gradients may still reach them. Type loss applies only to typed_slots [8,12,22] with desired_element C, N, C; slots 18 and 21 receive no type loss. The patch is a fixed-geometry, fixed-count joint local relocation: slot 12 native C -> desired N (N_minus_C +0.3068, best_donor A:ASP:175:N) and slot 22 native N -> desired C (N_minus_C +0.0763, best_donor A:VAL:116:N), with slot 8 retained C (N_minus_C -0.4136). All three sites share exchange_class neutral degree-two pyridine-type aromatic N / aromatic CH, with pyrrole [nH] and amide N excluded, so the source distinction between eligible pyridine N and excluded pyrrole/amide identities is preserved. The generated N decoder channel is treated as generic N until final chemical-role checks; no role term is enabled, so no neutral-charge or aromatic-neighbor decoder preference is asserted. Gradients act only on current coordinates through real coordinate and atomic-decoder Jacobians; affinity is not differentiated, discrete labels are not overridden, the new graph is not fixed, and no SMC is introduced. Counterfactual labels are scored hypotheses on fixed coordinates, not an observed continuation state or a promised score for new molecules. Expected observable changes: the endpoint and half terms pull the five supported slots toward the supplied half/final coordinates within the declared window [0.1,0.5] and dose (max_atom_step 0.15 A, max_cumulative_rms 6.0 A, native_rms_ratio 0.33, pointcloud_delta 1.0 A), with cumulative control RMS near the incumbent 0.5975 A and final local geometry RMS near 0.4795-0.5286 A if the frozen dose is respected; the cn_conditional type term shifts decoder N/C log probabilities at typed_slots [8,12,22] toward C, N, C. With type weight 0.3, identity response is measured, not enforced by geometry alone. Final affinity is primary; validity, failure, strain and actual local N/C response must be reported.
